description: This Java source file defines the InteropDataValidator class, which provides methods for validating and parsing various interoperation-related JSON requests within the Fineract platform. It handles transfer requests, identifier creation, transaction requests, and quotes, utilizing JSON parsing and validation helpers.

classes.name: InteropDataValidator
classes.description: A Spring component class providing validation and parsing methods for interoperation-related JSON requests in the Fineract platform.

methods.name: validateAndParseTransferRequest
methods.description: Validates and parses a transfer request JSON command into an InteropTransferRequestData object.

methods.name: validateAndParseCreateIdentifier
methods.description: Validates and parses a create identifier request with specified identifier type and value.

methods.name: validateAndParseCreateRequest
methods.description: Validates and parses a general interoperation transaction request.

methods.name: validateAndParseCreateQuote
methods.description: Validates and parses a quote creation request.

methods.name: validateAndParsePrepareTransfer
methods.description: Prepares and validates a transfer request, delegating to validateAndParseCreateTransfer.

methods.name: validateAndParseCreateTransfer
methods.description: Validates and parses a transfer request JSON command.

methods.name: extractJsonObject
methods.description: Extracts a JsonObject from a JsonCommand, throwing an exception if JSON is blank or invalid.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws a validation exception if errors are present in the DataValidatorBuilder.
